introHtml: Hanes paper bags combine the trusted quality of the Hanes brand with the practicality of custom paper packaging. Ideal for retail stores, trade shows, or corporate gifts, these bags offer a sustainable and durable option for carrying apparel or promotional items. Choose from various sizes and add your logo with screen printing or foil stamping for a professional look that aligns with the Hanes reputation.
